v_meaning: Everything fits and is within acceptable limits
quote: Safe to continue Everything fits and is within acceptable limits. Normal numbers, fasted, consent ready.

v_meaning: We don't yet know enough to decide
v_example: Liver tests abnormal → need a special scan of the bile ducts
quote: Needs more investigation We don't yet know enough to decide. Liver tests abnormal → need a special scan of the bile ducts.

v_meaning: A problem can be fixed (now in S2, or before a re-booked date in S1)
quote: Needs treatment / optimisation A problem can be fixed (now in S2, or before a re-booked date in S1). Dehydrated → give fluids. Diabetes badly controlled → postpone planned surgery to improve it.

v_meaning: Decision is beyond the trainee or affects anaesthesia
v_example: Patient ate 3 hours ago; heart rhythm irregular
quote: Needs senior or anaesthetic review Decision is beyond the trainee or affects anaesthesia. Patient ate 3 hours ago; heart rhythm irregular.

v_meaning: The patient may be in danger now
v_example: Blood pressure very low, oxygen falling, severe allergic reaction
quote: Emergency The patient may be in danger now. Blood pressure very low, oxygen falling, severe allergic reaction.
